entities.name: Kiel Maritime Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Kiel Maritime Museum is a museum in the German city of Kiel. It was established in 1978 in what had been the fish-auction hall in the Sartorikai area of the city. It shows the maritime history of Kiel.
